## ANTI-AI-SLOP
Severe visual regressions and accessibility issues identified in the Modal UI.

## FINDINGS
While the E2E tests and modal functionality improvements are solid, the visual implementation has serious UX flaws:
1. The backdrop uses `bg-accent/40`, which causes a massive, blinding "electric blue" color shift across the entire application when the search modal opens. This must be changed to a neutral dark overlay (e.g., `bg-black/60` or a dark slate) to improve focus.
2. On mobile devices, the search input box lacks sufficient contrast/borders, making it difficult for users to identify the target area to tap and type into.

Please fix these visual regressions and the lingering `deps: any[]` type violation.

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Not Approved

comments.body: Change the backdrop from `bg-accent/40` to a dark, desaturated color like `bg-black/60` to avoid a jarring full-screen blue color shift.
